title: A new Mistral option and a simpler Claude name
summary:
A new Mistral model and OpenAI-compatible routes arrived alongside a long day of image, sign-in, and website repairs.

Added `naughty`, an uncensored Mistral Nemo text model with tool support. Claude Haiku 4.5 is now listed as `claude`, with its previous name retained as an alias; three older model entries were removed.

Enter added standard OpenAI-compatible chat-completion and model-list paths. Public generation routes gained cross-origin preflight handling, image models can be listed without signing in, and the text GET route now returns plain text or raw audio rather than wrapping either in chat-completion JSON. The API reference was reorganized around text, image, and auth.

Image generation no longer rescales requested dimensions before sending them to a model, preserving valid sizes such as 1536×1024 for gptimage. Flux now ignores stale servers when judging load, avoiding unnecessary reductions in generation steps. NanoBanana’s images-per-Pollen estimate was corrected, and the image watermark gained a transparent color logo.

highlights.title: Naughty joins text models
highlights.text: Try `naughty`, an uncensored Mistral Nemo text model with tool support. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=naughty).

highlights.title: Standard chat completion path
highlights.text: OpenAI-compatible clients can use `https://enter.pollinations.ai/api/generate` as their base URL with `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/models`.
